facts.fact: The Gratuit (Free) plan on the Cursor pricing page is listed at $0 per month.
The Plus plan is listed at $8 per month and is described as the 'forfait de découverte' (discovery plan).
The Premium plan is listed at $30 per month and is marked as the most popular plan.
The Super plan is listed at $100 per month.
The Ultra plan is listed at $200 per month.
The Teams plan is listed at $30 or more per user per month.
The Enterprise plan is listed with custom ('sur mesure') pricing rather than a published price.
According to the page, the Premium plan provides 4x the usage of the Plus plan.
According to the page, the Super plan provides 15x the usage of the Plus plan.
According to the page, the Ultra plan provides 50x the usage of the Plus plan.
The page states that the displayed prices do not include applicable taxes or fees such as VAT.
facts.quote: Les prix affichés n’incluent pas les taxes ou frais applicables (par exemple, la TVA).

facts.fact: The page states that subscribers can cancel at any time, at least 24 hours before renewal to avoid additional charges.
facts.quote: Vous pouvez [résilier à tout moment](https://x.ai/legal/bundled-subscription-terms#cancel), au moins 24 heures avant le renouvellement

facts.fact: The page states that use of third-party models in Cursor is not included in the displayed monthly prices and must be purchased separately, billed by usage.
facts.quote: L’utilisation des modèles tiers dans Cursor n’est pas incluse dans les prix mensuels affichés et doit être achetée séparément.

facts.fact: The page states that the Plus plan includes only Grok models.
facts.quote: *Seuls les modèles Grok sont disponibles avec ce forfait

facts.fact: The page states that prices are subject to change.
facts.quote: Les prix sont susceptibles de changer.

facts.fact: The page lists the effective annual yield on X Money as 6.00% with direct deposit for the Free and Plus plans, and 6.00% for the higher tiers.
facts.quote: Rendement annuel effectif de 𝕏 Money | 6.00% avec dépôt direct | 6.00% avec dépôt direct | 6.00% | 6.00% | 6.00%

facts.fact: The page lists X Money cashback at 3% with direct deposit on the Free plan and 3% on the Plus plan.
facts.quote: Cashback 𝕏 Money | 3% avec dépôt direct | 3% | 3% | 3% | 3%

facts.fact: On the Free plan, usage of the Agent and Chat features is described as limited, with a limited number of agent requests and chat requests.
facts.quote:
Nombre limité de requêtes d’agent
*   Nombre limité de requêtes de Chat

facts.fact: The Teams plan usage is listed as 4-50x Plus.
facts.quote: | Utilisation | Limité | Basique | 4x Plus | 15x Plus | 50x Plus | 4-50x Plus | Mutualisée |

facts.fact: The page states that the Cursor Premium plan includes access to Cloud Agents and automations.
